title: Pair of scissors with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Left blade -->
  <polygon points="12,15 18,13 52,52 48,56" fill="#c0d8e8" />
  <polygon points="18,13 52,52 50,54 16,16" fill="#e8f4ff" />
  <!-- Right blade -->
  <polygon points="88,15 82,13 48,52 52,56" fill="#a0c4dc" />
  <polygon points="82,13 48,52 50,54 84,16" fill="#d4eaf8" />
  <!-- Blade shine left -->
  <polygon points="20,16 24,15 46,42 43,44" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6" />
  <!-- Blade shine right -->
  <polygon points="76,16 80,15 52,44 56,42" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5" />
  <!-- Pivot screw -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="6" fill="#8899aa" />
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="4" fill="#b0c0d0" />
  <circle cx="50" cy="54" r="2" fill="#dde8f0" />
  <!-- Left handle -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="80" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#ff6b6b" />
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="80" rx="13" ry="9" fill="#ff9a9a" />
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="80" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#ffd0d0" />
  <!-- Right handle -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="80" rx="18" ry="14" fill="#ff8e53" />
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="80" rx="13" ry="9" fill="#ffb88c" />
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="80" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#ffe0cc" />
  <!-- Handle connect left -->
  <path d="M 48 58 Q 35 62 28 66" stroke="#ff6b6b" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handle connect right -->
  <path d="M 52 58 Q 65 62 72 66" stroke="#ff8e53" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Smiling face on left handle area -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="24" cy="76" r="2.5" fill="#2a2a2a" />
  <circle cx="34" cy="76" r="2.5" fill="#2a2a2a" />
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="25" cy="75" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff" />
  <circle cx="35" cy="75" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff" />
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M 23 82 Q 29 88 35 82" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="81" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffb3b3" opacity="0.8" />
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="81" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffb3b3" opacity="0.8" />
  <!-- Smile on right handle -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="76" r="2.5" fill="#2a2a2a" />
  <circle cx="78" cy="76" r="2.5" fill="#2a2a2a" />
  <circle cx="69" cy="75" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff" />
  <circle cx="79" cy="75" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff" />
  <path d="M 67 82 Q 73 88 79 82" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="81" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffcc99" opacity="0.8" />
  <ellipse cx="82" cy="81" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffcc99" opacity="0.8" />
</svg>
